name: ANSI/IEEE Cam-operated limit switch form
aliases: IEEE Limit Switch Normally Open - Cam Driven
summary: IEEE-library form of cam-operated limit switch: a cam-operated limit switch changes its electrical contact state when a defined cam profile reaches the actuator.
description: This reference locates cam-operated limit switch in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented limit switches family. A cam-operated limit switch changes its electrical contact state when a defined cam profile reaches the actuator. Its position function depends on the documented cam and mechanism relationship. The public library uses HLS11S13 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Read the operating mechanism and the contact reference state together. Cross-reference every associated contact to the same device and show which movement, signal or reset changes its condition; the symbol alone does not establish the complete switching sequence.

Link the cam position to the electrical contact schedule. Cam actuation is a mechanical input, not an electrically programmed timer. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
